notes.title: 2023.01.05 update 更新补丁
notes.content:
1 调整了升级难度曲线，现在游戏后期更具挑战性。
2 调整了部分单位的能力数值。
3 调整了部分指令的效果。
4 增加了显示单位能力介绍的面板，现在鼠标悬停即可查看单位的能力。
5 在游戏界面底部增加了升级进度条。
6 美化了槽位的背景，现在槽位界面在保持直觉性的前提下视觉上更友好。
7 增加了单位能力值的变动时的动画。
8 修复了8级时单位在某个槽位消失的bug。
9 修复了锦囊按钮显示的bug。
10 修复了单位能力介绍显示错误的bug。
11 修复了开始新游戏后资源界面未及时清零的bug。

1 adjusted difficulty curve to make the late game more challenging.
2 adjusted units' utilities to fit them better to difficulty curves (most of which are buffs).
3 adjusted commands effects to fit better to difficulty curves.
4 added a new panel at left buttom corner to illustrate unit utility (triggered by unit mouse hover) for players convenience.
5 added a new "level up progress bar" at buttom of UI to visualize players' progress. 
6 modified unit cells' backgorund illustrations, so that they becomes better visual friendly.
7 added a new animation to units when they add or lose ability point.
8 fixed the bug that units disappear at certain cell in level 8.
9 fixed the bug of silk package button layout.
10 fixed wrong unit descriptions.
11 fixed the bug that resources panel fail to show right numbers at the start of the game.
